description: This file implements background process infrastructure for a Git-related project, providing functions for starting, stopping, reading status, and handshakes with subprocesses.

classes.name: struct subprocess_entry
classes.description: Represents a subprocess with associated command and process information.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Encapsulates details of a child process, including PIDs, arguments, and I/O file descriptors.

methods.name: int cmd2process_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparator for subprocess commands used in hash map entries.

methods.name: struct:subprocess_entry * subprocess_find_entry(struct hashmap * hashmap,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Finds a subprocess entry in the hash map based on the command string.

methods.name: int subprocess_read_status(int fd,struct strbuf * status)
methods.description: Reads the status of a subprocess from a file descriptor, capturing the 'status=' line.

methods.name: void subprocess_stop(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry)
methods.description: Stops a subprocess gracefully by sending SIGTERM and cleaning up.

methods.name: void subprocess_exit_handler(struct child_process * process)
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a subprocess exits, closing pipes and finishing commands.

methods.name: int subprocess_start(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * cmd,subprocess_start_fn startfn)
methods.description: Starts a subprocess with given command and initializes it, adding to the hashmap.

methods.name: int handshake_version(struct child_process * process,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version)
methods.description: Performs version handshake with a subprocess, verifying supported versions.

methods.name: int handshake_capabilities(struct child_process * process,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Negotiates capabilities with a subprocess, ensuring requested capabilities are supported.

methods.name: int subprocess_handshake(struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Conducts a handshake with the subprocess, verifying version and capabilities.

ctags.signature: (const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)

ctags.name: handshake_capabilities
ctags.signature: (struct child_process * process,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)

ctags.name: handshake_version
ctags.signature: (struct child_process * process,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version)

ctags.name: subprocess_handshake
ctags.signature: (struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)

ctags.pattern: /^int subprocess_start(struct hashmap *hashmap, struct subprocess_entry *entry, const char *cmd,$/
